question: Repair mixed-population TP/FN in validate_tracking while making full-cohort and eligibility-conditioned performance explicit to its callers.

proposed_contract.single_matching_pass: Match retained prediction points one-to-one to present ground truth at each frame; spatial gate must actually enforce <= match_radius_px. Classify matches by GT eligibility.
proposed_contract.all_presence: TP=all matched presence, FN=all unmatched presence, FP=unmatched predictions; frame recall uses fixed totalGTpresence. Report total and ever-matched ground-truth events including completely ineligible events.
proposed_contract.detectable: TP and FN restricted to eligibleGTpresence; predictions matched to ineligibleGT are excluded from conditional precision denominator, not counted physicalFP. Unmatched predictions remainFP; document ignored-ineligible-matches.
proposed_contract.eligibility: With movie: observed coat-channel local peak within existing8pixel radius window >=coat_floor. This is observed/movie-dependent, not noiseless truth. Without movie: allGTpresence eligible, clearly tagged.
proposed_contract.migration_proposal: Correct legacy top-level precision/recall/f1/tp/fp/fn to all-presence semantics, add contract version and explicit all_presence/detectable metric blocks; update repository sweep/CLI consumers with labeled metrics. Reviewer may recommend equally minimal explicit migration before acceptance.
proposed_contract.undefined_rates: New explicit metrics use null for zero denominator; compatibility top-level scalar zero fallback if retained, documented.
proposed_contract.lifetime_pairs: Preserve existing lifetime diagnostic scope unless a directly required minimal consistency change is justified; do not claim mean biological lifetime.

required_tests: Below-threshold matchedGT plus above-threshold missedGT separates all-presence andconditionalcounts
Add missedineligible frame: only full-cohort denominator changes
All-visibleGT metrics agree; no-movie fallback tagged
All-ineligibleGT and missing events retained, empty conditional denominators explicit
No truth/no predictions and unmatched prediction cases
Duplicate predictedpoints one-to-one matching; out-of-presence matching excluded
Spatial boundary exactlyat and justoutside match_radius
checks: Lead owns targeted pytest tests/test_tracking_validation.py plus tests/test_orchestration.py, with separately numbered logs per invocation. One current orchestration tracker run per invocation; direct Track fixture tests are not movie runs. No worker executes tests or benchmarks. Check relevant syntax/lint and gitdiffcheck.
stop_condition: One reviewed minimal metric repair with targeted tests or a precise blocker; no detector/linker/inverse changes, empirical work, new simulation grid or edits to frozen research evidence.
